drugs.name: Omega-3 fatty acid (DHA EE) & Vitamin E [(all-rac)-α-tocopheryl acetate]

primary_endpoint: Change in hepatic fat fraction from baseline to 6 months, comparing Vitamin E and DHA EE with placebo.
efficacy_outcome: Hepatic fat fraction changed by −6.8 with DHA EE plus Vitamin E and −8.2 with placebo; no statistical comparison was reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: Vitamin E 0/34, DHA EE 0/34, combination 1/67, and placebo 1/70; deaths: 0, 0, 0, and 1, respectively.
